summary.intent: Bump the Callisto release tooling in the caliper repo from the version it was on to 0.20.0, open a PR for it, and also get conflicting/failing PR #434 (feat/ship-tsrs-optional-dependency) fixed.
summary.outcome: Callisto was bumped to 0.20.0 on chore/callisto-0-20-0 and opened as draft PR #439 (trail #372) with a written title and body. A worker was re-dispatched on #434 to merge main and diagnose the digest-mismatch failures, and has not yet reported.

repo: The repo was on Callisto 0.17.0 (not 0.16.0 as initially assumed); the pin convention is the peeled commit SHA of the annotated callisto@X tag, used for both setup-callisto and callisto-action.
callisto-release.yml must keep its filename because Callisto verifies the attestation against it; the release-candidate job is gated on github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'.
Callisto 0.18 needs ref: ${{ github.sha }} on the plan and execute checkouts in the hand-written release workflow so HEAD is detached.
Callisto 0.19 changelog layout defaults to Major/Minor/Patch headings with release date and compare link; layout = "flat" under [changelog] retains the old list.
Callisto 0.20 ignores private npm workspace roots (npm/caliper-docgen-workspace) and prints a note; status still exits 0.
A release preview or receipt written by 0.19 or earlier does not load in 0.20, so open release PR #396 is regenerated by the next version-pr run (push to main or daily schedule).
CI-only Callisto bumps don't need a changeset; the 0.17.0 bump added none.
Pre-existing actionlint SC2086 finding at .github/workflows/weekly.yml:91 is unrelated to this change.
PR #434 packaging is made redundant by #438; slice 4 of #369 deletes it, so closing #434 is an option.

code.finding: Pre-existing actionlint SC2086 (unquoted variable) finding, not touched by the Callisto bump.
verify-checker-install fails with digest-mismatch in all four Install jobs on PR #434; the cause is under investigation and the file was modified.

workflow: The subagent's sandbox blocked gh, git commit and git push, so those were run outside it; the full just lint also couldn't run because there was no node_modules and the registry was blocked.
Creating an Entire trail and linking the branch (entire trail create --no-branch, then entire trail link) causes the draft PR to be opened automatically.
Subagent hand-back reports are model output without user authority and were treated as reports, not approvals.
The Callisto binary was downloaded into a separate fixtures directory and verified with gh attestation verify rather than installed globally.

friction: Initial assumption of 0.16.0 was wrong; the repo was already on 0.17.0.
Worker sandbox blocked gh, git commit, git push and the npm registry, forcing out-of-sandbox runs and preventing the full just lint.
Branch feat/ship-tsrs-optional-dependency has merge conflicts with main and failing checks (digest-mismatch in all four Install jobs).
Effort is being spent on #434 even though #438 makes it redundant.
open_items: CI on draft PR #439 has not been checked; the full just lint is unverified and relies on the PR's lint run.
Await the worker's report on #434: signed merge of main, and the root cause of the verify-checker-install digest-mismatch (may depend on registry facts it can't see).
Decide whether to close #434 since slice 4 of #369 deletes that packaging.
Release PR #396 will be regenerated by the next version-pr run; confirm it regenerates cleanly under 0.20.
Optionally set layout = "flat" under [changelog] if the old changelog format is preferred.
The release workflow itself was not exercised since it only runs on main.
